title: 真实JDK17启动迁移验收：不能只删CMS到能启动，实测堆/GC/容器参数及OOM诊断
answer:
```python
def migrate(legacy,diagnostics):
    import pathlib
    approved=['-XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC','-Xmx64m','-XX:+UseContainerSupport','-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError','-Dapplication.mode=training','-Dunrelated=preserve']
    if legacy!=approved:raise ValueError('unreviewed legacy option set')
    root=pathlib.Path(diagnostics)
    if not root.is_absolute() or not root.is_dir():raise ValueError('existing isolated diagnostic directory required')
    return ['-XX:+UseG1GC',*legacy[1:],'-XX:HeapDumpPath='+str(root/'oom.hprof'),'-Xlog:gc*:file='+str(root/'gc.log')+':time,level,tags']
```

原题知识说明：
交付参数到能力的对应表、启动日志和代表负载比较。识别已移除、忽略、改名及默认行为变化的选项，区分堆大小、GC策略、容器识别和诊断输出；不能简单删到能启动为止。使用开发提供的匹配制品验证类库、反射和插件兼容，再核对有效参数及内存边界。验收正常负载、长时GC、内存不足和退出转储，记录尾延迟及进程总RSS。若不满足目标，回到受支持旧JDK与原参数组合；新版本产生的诊断文件或业务数据不一定可由旧工具解释，应保留格式版本并独立核查。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

body:
## 操作任务
实现migrate(legacy,diagnostics)。legacy必须精确为题给六个有序批准参数：-XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC、-Xmx64m、-XX:+UseContainerSupport、-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError、-Dapplication.mode=training、-Dunrelated=preserve；其他或缺少参数ValueError，不盲删未知项。diagnostics为既有绝对隔离目录。返回JDK17参数list：用批准的-XX:+UseG1GC替换已移除CMS，保留后五项，新增-XX:HeapDumpPath=<dir>/oom.hprof和-Xlog:gc*:file=<dir>/gc.log:time,level,tags，不修改输入或目录其他文件。验收先实测旧选项在JDK17被拒，再启动同一匹配测试制品，读取有效堆上限64MiB、G1收集器、UseContainerSupport和原应用属性；受限分配实际触发OutOfMemoryError，以42退出并生成真实HPROF与GC日志。不能仅以退出到main或java -version为成功。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际现有OpenJDK17目标运行时、MXBean有效参数、64MiB堆OOM及自有临时HPROF/统一日志，所有大诊断文件随夹具清理，不打入交付包。未启动旧JDK对照、未验证生产制品插件/反射、长负载尾延迟或总RSS预算，G1不是CMS语义等价证明；这是批准替代策略的目标启动/诊断契约。只给单次java进程参数，不切换宿主默认JDK或身份，不部署、不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
import task
assert os.geteuid()==1000 and sys.platform=='linux'
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
legacy=['-XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC','-Xmx64m','-XX:+UseContainerSupport','-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError','-Dapplication.mode=training','-Dunrelated=preserve']
before=copy.deepcopy(legacy)
version=subprocess.run(['java','-version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
assert version.returncode==0 and 'version "17.' in version.stderr,version.stderr
old=subprocess.run(['java',*legacy,'-version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
assert old.returncode!=0 and 'UseConcMarkSweepGC' in old.stderr and ('Unrecognized VM option' in old.stderr or 'Unrecognized option' in old.stderr)
compiled=subprocess.run(['javac','checks/JvmOptionsExperiment.java'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
assert compiled.returncode==0,compiled.stderr
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:target_jdk17_effective_intents_and_real_oom_gc_diagnostics',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jvm diagnostics ') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);sentinel=root/'unrelated.txt';sentinel.write_text('preserve')
 args=task.migrate(legacy,str(root))
 assert legacy==before and isinstance(args,list) and all(isinstance(arg,str) for arg in args)
 run=subprocess.run(['java',*args,'-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-cp','checks','JvmOptionsExperiment'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
 assert run.returncode==42 and 'EFFECTIVE_JDK17_HEAP_67108864_G1_CONTAINER_TRUE_PROPERTIES_PRESERVED' in run.stdout,'effective JVM intent or bounded OOM exit differs: '+run.stdout+run.stderr
 assert 'CONTROLLED_OUT_OF_MEMORY_ACTUAL:java.lang.OutOfMemoryError' in run.stderr
 dump=root/'oom.hprof';log=root/'gc.log'
 assert dump.is_file() and dump.stat().st_size>1024*1024,'actual OOM heap dump missing'
 with dump.open('rb') as stream:assert stream.read(32).startswith(b'JAVA PROFILE 1.0.')
 assert log.is_file() and 'Using G1' in log.read_text() and 'GC(' in log.read_text(),'actual unified GC diagnostic log missing'
 assert sentinel.read_text()=='preserve'
 for changed in [legacy+['-XX:UnknownUnreviewedOption=1'],legacy[:-1]]:
  try:task.migrate(changed,str(root))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unknown option blindly discarded to achieve startup')
 print('NATIVE_TARGET_JDK17_REMOVED_CMS_REJECTED_EFFECTIVE_G1_64M_CONTAINER_FLAGS_AND_APPLICATION_PROPERTIES',flush=True)
 print('NATIVE_ACTUAL_BOUNDED_OOM_HEAP_DUMP_HPROF_AND_UNIFIED_GC_LOG_PRESERVED_INTENTS',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
